title: Read-phase machine
statement: For a natural-number tape count $m$ and two work-tape indices $r,s	ext{ in }	ext{Fin}(m)$, define an $m$-work-tape machine with Boolean work symbols and states given by the sum of read-phase labels and optional Boolean values. Its initial state is the equality-checking phase; in a read-phase state it uses the corresponding read-phase transition, while in an optional-Boolean state it uses the default action that keeps the heads stationary and enters no successor state.
caveat: The default action and the read-phase transition function are referenced through definitions not fully supplied here, so their precise behavior cannot be stated from this snippet alone.
